remarks: Modern Systems, Timeless Design combined w/privacy, scenic surroundings and proximity to New York City. This well-maintained contemporary home w/ city water provides a fantastic floor plan and unique architectural features. An expansive eat-in-kitchen, with center island, granite countertops, double wall ovens, built-in computer desk, and new SS appliances, connects the Sunroom, FR, Dining Room. Kitchen flows into FR with soaring ceilings and large transom windows. Sliding glass doors on side and rear access the stone patio and large Trex deck respectively.  Sunroom with french doors, cathedral ceilings & floor to ceiling windows illuminates every corner of the open space. This spacious home preesen flexibility with a layout that includes 4 bedrooms on the second level and a versatile 5th bedroom on the main level w/ easy access to a full bathroom. In 2022/2023, the entire home underwent major systems upgrades, including a new HVAC system, hot water heater, appliances, windows, electrical, lighting, flooring and new whole house generator (2024), providing peace of mind for years to come. There is not enough space here to communicate the extensive list of upgrades and improvements so a separate list is available. The conditioned walkout LL has mudroom leading to 2 car garage with new epoxy floor and additional 3 large rooms with sliding glass doors to back yard. This home is truly a move-in-ready sanctuary, offering tranquility & natural beauty in a prime locaton.
